results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Decide discovery path: use COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB by default; only use SERPAPI_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH if it is configured/runnable (jobs engine + active connection).

[Optional (if geo scoping is needed)] [Prerequisite]: Resolve and reuse a canonical location using SERPAPI_GET_AVAILABLE_LOCATION_OPTIONS_FOR_GOOGLE_SEARCHES or SERPAPI_LOCATIONS_LIST (avoid invalid/unstable geo strings).
[Required] [Step]: Run COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB with several remote-role keyword variants; collect URLs/snippets from results.citations and prefer first-party employer/ATS links over reposts.

[Required] [Next Step]: For a shortlist, use COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT to verify remote eligibility and extract requirements/compensation text; if a URL errors (e.g., not found), replace it with another citation.

[Optional (if you want structured job SERP results or broader coverage)] [Next Step]: Run SERPAPI_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH and extract listings from response.data.jobs_results (or response.data_preview.jobs_results); if next_page_token is returned, paginate by passing it back unchanged until no token remains, then aggregate/dedupe by job_id, else share_link, else title+company_name.
[Fallback] [Fallback]: If SERPAPI_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH returns only preview/truncated content, use SERPAPI_GET_SEARCH_ARCHIVE to pull the full stored payload and re-extract jobs_results.
known_pitfalls: [SERPAPI_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH] HTTP 429 "Your account has run out of searches" indicates quota exhaustion and typically won’t resolve via retry.
[SERPAPI_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH] HTTP 400 can occur when location is not a valid geo value; keep remote intent in the query and use location helpers for geo scoping.
[SERPAPI_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH] HTTP 400 "Invalid `next_page_token`" occurs if the token is altered, reused across different queries, or not passed exactly as returned.
[SERPAPI_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH] Success can still mean no results: data.error plus search_information.jobs_results_state can indicate emptiness; jobs_results may also appear only under data_preview.
[COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT] Page text can be truncated at max_characters and some targets can return HTTP 404; treat as unverified and fetch an alternate citation or raise the character cap.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Parse batched SERPAPI_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH outputs (data vs data_preview) and capture empty-result signals
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json
resp=json.loads(RAW_JSON)
rows=[]
for r in resp.get('results',[]):
 d=(r.get('response') or {}).get('data') or (r.get('response') or {}).get('data_preview') or {}
 err=d.get('error'); state=(d.get('search_information') or {}).get('jobs_results_state')
 for j in (d.get('jobs_results') or []):
  rows.append({'job_id':j.get('job_id'),'title':j.get('title') or j.get('job_title'),'company_name':j.get('company_name'),'share_link':j.get('share_link'),'source_link':j.get('source_link'),'posted_at':(j.get('detected_extensions') or {}).get('posted_at'),'error':err,'state':state})
len(rows)
```

COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB.description: Perform a web search using the Exa API. Returns a nested structure: narrative summary under results.answer, sources under results.citations (and optionally results.organic_results). Prioritize results.citations as primary evidence over results.answer, which can be vague. Only indexes publicly available content — no paywalled, login-gated, or private content. No date filters enforced; include recency terms in query and verify dates in snippets manually. Throttle to ~1–2 requests/second; bursty queries trigger HTTP 429. Large responses may be stored remotely — use structure_info to locate results.answer and results.citations.

query.description: The search query for the Composio Exa API. Must be non-empty; using any other parameter name (e.g., 'q') causes an invalid-request error. Include qualifiers (year, region, platform, intent) for better results — broad queries return generic content; excessive site: or quoted-term filters can return zero results. Add disambiguating terms (city, role, domain) when searching for people or organizations with common names.

SERPAPI_GET_AVAILABLE_LOCATION_OPTIONS_F.description: Tool to get available location options for Google searches. Returns location names, codes, and identifiers that can be used in the location parameter. Use when you need to find valid location values for search queries.

q.description: Restricts your search to locations that contain the supplied string. For example, 'Austin' will find 'Austin, TX', 'The University of Texas at Austin', etc. If not provided, returns general location options.

limit.description: Limits the number of locations returned. Must be between 1 and 10. If not specified, returns all matching locations up to the maximum of 10.
